method: Elimination-stage ranks; ties within each stage. Scores from different pairings are not global preference measurements.

proposals.title: Steady metadata rail
proposals.reason: A stable rail can leave duration, date and recurrence equally prominent in its closed summary.

proposals.title: Semantic one-line status replacement
proposals.reason: Status-only direction does not organize price, duration and recurrence editors.

proposals.title: Native details groups
proposals.reason: Native disclosure alone does not identify which fields should stay visible.

proposals.title: Exception gutter
proposals.reason: Gutter exceptions can fill every row in historical views.

proposals.title: Stable essential spine
proposals.reason: Essential spine needs a rule for choosing essential fields.

proposals.title: Context-first mobile folio
proposals.reason: Global context folio is less concrete for complex form settings.

proposals.title: Resume-work compact header
proposals.reason: Start-first header does not handle clutter in non-execution modals.

proposals.title: One calm context tray
proposals.reason: A context tray combines several unrelated control groups.

proposals.title: Inherited context line
proposals.reason: Shared inherited captions require proof every descendant matches.

proposals.title: Completion lane
proposals.reason: Trailing inspection lane steals width from deep nested titles.

proposals.title: Persistent scope watermark
proposals.reason: Scope watermark does not organize other optional facts.

proposals.title: Measured wrapping priority
proposals.reason: Wrapping adapts geometry but can leave every field visible.

proposals.title: Named summary drawer
proposals.reason: Summary drawer introduces focus handoff for simple fields.

proposals.title: Three disclosure shelves
proposals.reason: Three shelves add competing disclosure labels at each nesting level.

proposals.title: Stable focus emphasis
proposals.reason: Focus emphasis does not actually reduce repeated metadata.

proposals.title: Shape-and-text hierarchy
proposals.reason: Shape plus text may still repeat progress in several places.

proposals.title: Period provenance captions
proposals.reason: Provenance captions do not resolve repeated progress bars.

proposals.title: Depth-independent context rows
proposals.reason: Context outside indentation can appear attached to the wrong sibling.

proposals.title: Outline with inline inspector
proposals.reason: Inspector before every section pushes tasks farther down.

proposals.title: Origin ledger
proposals.reason: Origin ledger increases reading load when many frequencies contribute.

proposals.title: Deadline action row
proposals.reason: A separate deadline row remains vertically expensive.

proposals.title: One summary sentence
proposals.reason: Deadline and estimate sentence is lengthy with mixed metadata.

proposals.title: Ledger with single material toolbar
proposals.reason: Ledger totals compete with titles on small screens.

proposals.title: Reminder synopsis controls
proposals.reason: Synopsis can become overloaded with contextual text.

proposals.title: Context sentence and fact ledger
proposals.reason: A fact ledger plus Options can repeat scope information for every nested section.

proposals.title: Scope transaction popover
proposals.reason: Transaction popover implies confirmation for a boolean inclusion setting.

proposals.title: Single task action lane
proposals.reason: A nested task at 320px cannot accommodate completion, title, due exception and a trailing information lane without compressing text or adding repeated controls.

proposals.title: Period watermark heading
proposals.reason: A current-month title with a rolled-over section can imply that the section completion belongs to the visible month unless its exception remains explicit.

proposals.title: Focusable side inspector
proposals.reason: Opening an inspector beside a five-level list shrinks already constrained task rows; an unrelated selected object can remain displayed while the user acts elsewhere.

proposals.title: Sticky active-section context
proposals.reason: A sticky active section can cover focused task controls at high zoom, especially when global navigation also remains fixed above it.

proposals.title: Caregiver scope confirmation sentence
proposals.reason: Repeated global and local scope sentences can consume the entire initial viewport before any cleaning task appears on a 320px phone.

proposals.title: Section action shelf
proposals.reason: A long list with several open section action shelves puts repeated controls before tasks and makes collapse look like a management command.

proposals.title: Two separate disclosures
proposals.reason: Two 44px disclosures crowd a nested section's short header.

proposals.title: Household ledger
proposals.reason: Quiet context columns still compress a long shared-house title.

proposals.title: Read and plan tabs
proposals.reason: Plan tab conceals task context during repeated scope changes.

proposals.title: Maintenance inspector dock
proposals.reason: Inspector subject may change while an editor is open.

proposals.title: Return-to-work checkpoint
proposals.reason: A returning user's monthly list can accumulate a checkpoint, a period navigator and a Start confirmation sentence that repeat the same context three times.

proposals.title: Context before options
proposals.reason: Context opens a read-only summary that then routes to controls; changing a simple scope switch requires inspection and a second navigation decision.

proposals.title: History margin notes
proposals.reason: Margin notes create a second scan path for each nested section.

proposals.title: Historical evidence sheet
proposals.reason: Tabs split history evidence across multiple invisible panels.

proposals.title: Duration emphasis without movement
proposals.reason: Duration tiers can dominate a list containing an urgent unpaid bill with no duration, making a five-minute optional task seem more actionable.

proposals.title: Parallel contrast mode
proposals.reason: A monthly list with three parallel tasks gains a mode selector before the user can identify the actual elapsed estimate; this adds another decision rather than reducing clutter.

proposals.title: Deadline exceptions shelf
proposals.reason: A task due on the last day of a selected month may look redundant with month context despite its precise deadline being important for planning.

proposals.title: Flat inspector hierarchy
proposals.reason: Deletion makes the single inspector reference a stale subject.

proposals.title: Unified glass context capsule
proposals.reason: One capsule obscures whether changing period also changes inclusion.

proposals.title: Frequency map disclosure
proposals.reason: A frequency map spanning twenty nested sections can become a second navigation hierarchy that users must search just to change one section's inclusion.

proposals.title: Scope typography tiers
proposals.reason: Typography tiers require learning weight distinctions.

proposals.title: Single-column command stack
proposals.reason: Opening several full-width command stacks in a monthly list places dozens of 44px rows between tasks, weakening comparison and completion scanning.

proposals.title: Mobile object sheets
proposals.reason: Opening a focused editor from an object sheet can lose the original trigger.

proposals.title: Explicit planning mode
proposals.reason: Returning in Ejecutar hides that accumulated scope remains enabled.

proposals.title: Two-column scope ledger
proposals.reason: Propias/Incluidas duration columns imply additive elapsed time for parallel work.

proposals.title: Estimated-work spine
proposals.reason: Workload spine hides scope in Summary and squeezes nested titles.

proposals.title: Details-on-demand row expansion
proposals.reason: After opening six task Details regions, the list recreates the original metadata wall.

proposals.title: Persistent calm density preference
proposals.reason: A user switches Compacta in one list then unexpectedly sees another list become compact after navigation.

proposals.title: Scoped action lists
proposals.reason: Inspecting duration through Actions mixes facts with destructive commands.

proposals.title: Heading-first spoken outline
proposals.reason: A screen reader announces the same long period and recurrence description on every task.

proposals.title: Definition-sheet information architecture
proposals.reason: Three generic Info buttons conceal where accumulated routines can be changed.

proposals.title: Keyboard command toolbar
proposals.reason: Comandos opened beside Cocina implies global inclusion changes Cocina alone.

proposals.title: Breadcrumb context rail
proposals.reason: Clicking a breadcrumb period segment appears to navigate to a parent rather than open a selector.

proposals.title: Thumb-reachable context dock
proposals.reason: The bottom dock collides with existing navigation and hides the last checkbox.

proposals.title: Date-first bottom sheet
proposals.reason: Closing the date sheet leaves accumulated inclusion impossible to identify.

proposals.title: Touch-safe information gutters
proposals.reason: Five nested levels and two 44px gutters leave a long title barely readable.

proposals.title: Single-column action stack
proposals.reason: At 320px and 200% text, three separate 44px header rows push the first task below the fold.

proposals.title: Context paragraphs with labeled edits
proposals.reason: Date, recurrence, price and related-list paragraphs become taller than task titles.

proposals.title: Typography-driven contextual scaling
proposals.reason: Oversized titles and full sentences bury the list's selected period.

proposals.title: High-contrast command bands
proposals.reason: Opaque command bands on six expanded sections become the strongest visual feature on the page.

proposals.title: Structured receipt layout
proposals.reason: A nonshopping section's receipt subtotal looks like a monetary total despite representing active minutes.

proposals.title: Magnifiable information panel
proposals.reason: Full-width edit buttons require much scrolling before a low-vision user finds section Options.

proposals.title: Start scope gate
proposals.reason: Duration inspection requires opening Start, which looks like immediate launch.

proposals.title: Time accounting sentence
proposals.reason: Active, parallel, inherited and period qualifiers create four mobile lines.

proposals.title: Week notebook
proposals.reason: A notebook annotation looks like noninteractive prose, so the user never finds period navigation.

proposals.title: Unfolded cleaning checklist
proposals.reason: A first-time cleaner sees every section collapsed and must open each before completing one reminder.

proposals.title: One material per hierarchy
proposals.reason: On a patterned background, matte sections blend together and plain count links appear inert.

proposals.title: Maintenance action itinerary
proposals.reason: A section with 40 tasks hides its Start footer below several screens.

proposals.title: Shopping receipt footer
proposals.reason: A receipt beneath 100 tasks hides totals and active routine scope.

proposals.title: Dual context receipt
proposals.reason: A routine list with no prices still renders Pending euros and a second receipt line.

proposals.title: Explicit field chooser
proposals.reason: A user changing time-of-day must open Edit details, choose a field, then find the original cycling control.

proposals.title: Value-first typographic rows
proposals.reason: A large page cost dominates a reminder list with one priced task.

proposals.title: Section breadcrumb actions
proposals.reason: Five breadcrumb ancestors occupy three lines above every nested section.

proposals.title: Ancestor summary transfer
proposals.reason: The highest ancestor shows 90 minutes while a child appears to own that total after its sibling collapses.

proposals.title: Current-context ribbon
proposals.reason: Sticky ribbon plus navigation covers the first row at large text.

proposals.title: Historical action caption
proposals.reason: Thirty repeated historical captions overwhelm a review task list.

proposals.title: Historical context guardrail
proposals.reason: The historical masthead consumes phone height even for today's view.

proposals.title: Duration selection gutter
proposals.reason: At 320px a 44px duration gutter beside deeply nested titles leaves only a few characters.

proposals.title: Estimate ledger strip
proposals.reason: Two estimate columns conceal current inclusion until the selector opens.

proposals.title: One open time calculator
proposals.reason: Opening task B's Time calculator closes task A's breakdown while keyboard focus remains inside A.

proposals.title: Parallel lane pair
proposals.reason: The two time lanes suggest active 30 plus parallel 20 means 50 elapsed minutes.

proposals.title: Concurrency explanation rail
proposals.reason: A list with no parallel tasks still shows a Parallel label and total at every section.

proposals.title: Parallel footnote drawer
proposals.reason: A parallel-only task shows zero Active estimate and a footnote the user misses before Start.

proposals.title: Calendar sentence hierarchy
proposals.reason: Calendar sentences repeat dates on every task while inclusion remains unclear.

proposals.title: Urgency-weighted caption line
proposals.reason: A long deadline plus duration produces three caption lines on every routine task at 320px.

proposals.title: Dense action matrix
proposals.reason: Mobile stacking produces date, estimate and Options controls on every nested row.

proposals.title: Expandable dense columns
proposals.reason: Users disable recurrence columns, then hunt settings to restore them.

proposals.title: Baseline grid density
proposals.reason: Five 44px metadata targets recreate multiple dense lines per task.

proposals.title: Visible commitment ribbon
proposals.reason: Every recurring task repeats a commitment ribbon, restoring the routine-heavy wall of metadata.

proposals.title: Scope annotation margins
proposals.reason: Left annotations plus nesting leave just a few title characters at 320px.

proposals.title: User-pinned context fields
proposals.reason: A user pins duration globally and unintentionally reveals it on every shopping task in another list.

proposals.title: Recurrence route selectors
proposals.reason: Every daily task repeats frequency beside Details, rebuilding the original routine-heavy clutter.

proposals.title: Recurrence inheritance sentence
proposals.reason: A section says Weekly while one custom-cycle task is incorrectly treated as inheriting Weekly.
